data_source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR via NASA/ESA Gateway

excluded_acquisitions.reason: High radar noise / severe ionospheric scintillation

processing_method: Sentinel-1 Dual-Pol Amplitude Ratio & Coherence Change Detection (SAR Beat Test)
persistence_result: Change persisted across 3/3 (100.0%) valid later acquisitions (meets >= 66.7% threshold)
reasons_for_label: Sufficient post-event observations available: 3 valid satellite acquisitions evaluated (minimum required: 3).
Beat Test repeated-detection requirement satisfied: change detected in 3/3 valid passes (100.0%), meeting the >= 66.7% persistence threshold.
Confounder check clear: no severe weather, ionospheric noise, or steep topographic distortion flagged.
1 acquisition(s) excluded for data quality reasons and excluded from observation counts.
Independent reference agreement recorded for context but does not determine this evidence label (PRD Section 9).
known_limitations: Radar speckle noise requires multi-look adaptive filtering.
Wind roughening over open water can induce backscatter variance.
Ground truth validation has not yet been ingested.
Current demonstration uses illustrative Sentinel-1 metadata.
